summary: Yum China filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026, announcing a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire Willow Glade Investments from Yum! Brands for US$1.2 billion in cash. The acquired entity holds Pizza Hut intellectual property and related rights in China. Yum China will also amend its existing KFC/Taco Bell master license agreement. Consideration is fixed and will be funded by cash and debt. Closing is subject to no law or order prohibiting the transaction. The acquisition consolidates brand rights; key watch is regulatory clearance and financing details.
